params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `family`, `model`, `os`, `os_type`

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: family
params.description: Device Category of the client device

params.name: client_type
params.description: Filter results by client type. enum: `wireless`, `wired`, `vty`

params.name: mfg
params.description: Manufacturer name of the client device

params.name: os
params.description: Operating System name and version of the client device

params.description: Operating system name of the client device

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration

params.name: interval
params.description: Aggregation works by giving a time range plus interval (e.g. 1d, 1h, 10m) where aggregation function would be applied to.

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order.

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.
